title: NVIDIA/cosmos
abstract:
NVIDIA Cosmos is an open platform of world models, datasets, and tools that enables developers to build Physical AI for robots, autonomous vehicles, smart infrastructure, and more.

# NVIDIA Cosmos ### World Foundation Models for Physical AI **One model family that sees, reasons, simulates, and acts.** [ ](https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3) [ ](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3/technical-report.pdf) [ ](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3/) [ ](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cosmos/discussions) [**Try it in your browser**](https://build.nvidia.com/nvidia/cosmos3-nano-reasoner) · [**Quickstart**](#generate-your-first-video) · [**Find your path**](#find-your-path) · [**Model Family**](#models) Physics-aware generation A Newton's cradle in motion: momentum transfer rendered with physical fidelity Transfer World-scenario control layout → photoreal driving video Action policy Policy run: "put the screwdriver and the glove in the purple container" Simulation Generate synthetic data and create simulation for autonomous driving Action-conditioned World Model Forward dynamics: egocentric rollout from input camera + hand pose World reasoning Reason in complex real-world scenarios: a rolling ball means a child or pet may follow --- ## What's new - **[Jul 2026]** [Cosmos3-Edge](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos3-Edge) released — the 4B tier for on-device, real-time deployment (Jetson AGX Orin / Thor / RTX Pro 6000). - **[May 2026]** Cosmos 3 released: [HF collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3) · [Technical Report](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3/technical-report.pdf). ## What is Cosmos? NVIDIA Cosmos is an open platform for building physical AI applications — robots, autonomous vehicles, and smart infrastructure — providing better data, better environment, better starting point, and better tooling for physical AI developers. **Cosmos 3**, the current model family, is a suite of omnimodal world models built on a unified Mixture-of-Transformers architecture ([technical report](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3/technical-report.pdf)). >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 Cosmos 3 系列全模态世界模型，基于统一的 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，用单一模型家族同时支持物理感知生成、世界场景控制（layout→驾驶视频）、策略执行、仿真数据合成、动作条件前向动力学（相机+手部姿态的自中心 rollout）与世界推理，并配套开放数据集与工具链，按 nano/super/edge 多规模分层发布。


# 一、动机

> 物理 AI（机器人、自动驾驶、智能基础设施）发展受限于物理世界数据稀缺、仿真环境不真实、缺乏可控制/可推理的世界模型；现有视频生成模型普遍缺乏物理保真度、动作条件建模与世界推理能力，难以直接作为具身智能的训练与仿真基座。


# 二、方法

> 提出 Cosmos 3 系列全模态世界模型，基于统一的 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，用单一模型家族同时支持物理感知生成、世界场景控制（layout→驾驶视频）、策略执行、仿真数据合成、动作条件前向动力学（相机+手部姿态的自中心 rollout）与世界推理，并配套开放数据集与工具链，按 nano/super/edge 多规模分层发布。


# 三、核心实验结果

> Cosmos 3 于 2026 年 5 月发布并公开 HuggingFace 模型集合与技术报告；2026 年 7 月新增 Cosmos3-Edge，为 4B 参数量级，可在 Jetson AGX Orin / Thor / RTX Pro 6000 上端侧实时部署；模型能力覆盖运动物理保真渲染（如牛顿摆动量传递）、布局到真实驾驶视频的转换、以及'把螺丝刀和手套放进紫色容器'这类语言指令驱动的策略执行。


# 四、对我的启发

> 官方摘要与主页以能力展示和发布信息为主，缺少量化基准、架构细节与训练数据规模，需细读技术报告后才能评估其相对既有 video world model 的真实增益；对本课题的启发在于：世界模型可同时充当仿真器、数据生成器与策略骨干，端侧 4B 的实时推理路线也为真机部署提供了可行路径。
